---
agent: 'agent'
description: 'Generate JSDoc/TSDoc documentation for functions, components, and modules'
---

Generate comprehensive documentation for the selected code:

## For Functions/Methods:

- Add JSDoc/TSDoc comments describing purpose
- Document all parameters with types and descriptions
- Document return values
- Include usage examples for complex functions
- Note any side effects or important behaviors

## For React Components:

- Document component purpose and use cases
- Describe props with TypeScript types
- Include usage examples showing common scenarios
- Note any important state management or side effects
- Document exported hooks and utilities

## For Convex Functions:

- Document query/mutation purpose
- Describe all arguments and validation rules
- Document return value structure
- Include example usage from React components
- Note any database schema dependencies

## Style:

- Use clear, concise language
- Provide practical examples
- Follow TypeScript/JSDoc conventions
- Keep documentation close to code
